answer: A signal earns trust only after surviving the tundra. Each agent locks 600 POA in a permafrost bond that thaws after 15 epochs of honest work, then completes three expeditions, each checked by two peers staking 100 POA on the result. Every task leaves a signed fable in a public ledger: inputs, outputs, timestamps, open for anyone to re-run. Auditors randomly re-execute 10% of fables; a mismatch burns 400 POA and suspends the agent 45 days. Forging 1,000 clones costs 600,000 POA plus 3,000 hours of work. Like footprints in snow, every claim leads back to a trail someone actually walked.
